name: Magus Signifer Mageknight
body:
While the signifer warmage focuses more on combat magic, another branch of signifers blend the magic into their own weapons. This seamless combination of martial and magic is a powerful tool in bringing law and order to the realm.

Alignment: A signifer mageknight must be lawfullyaligned.

Catechesis (Ex)

At 1st level, a signifer mageknight is given some training in the religious aspects of the hellknights which gives them a hardened mind and body. The signifer mageknight gains Warrior Priest as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites.

However, their arcane pool is restricted to 1/2 their magus level (minimum 1). This ability modifies arcane pool.

Order (Ex)

A signifer battlepriest must join an order of hellknights.

Signifer Mask (Ex)

At 5th level, a signifer mageknight has earned the right to bear their signifer mask. They must pass the test and kill a devil single handedly before getting their mask. Once they do, they receive a signifer mask which grants the signifer mageknight a +2 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks and on saves against visual effects.

Additionally, the signifer mask can be used once per day to cast any one spell that the signifer mageknight has in their spellbook and is capable of casting, even if the spell is not prepared. This spell is treated like any other spell cast by the signifer mageknight, including casting time, duration, and other effects dependent on the magus’s level. This spell cannot be modified by metamagic feats or other abilities.

The signifer mageknight can add special abilities to their signifer mask as any other wondrous item as if they have the Craft Wondrous Item feat, so long as they meet the level requirements of the feat.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 5th level.

Discern Lies (Sp)

At 6th level, a signifer mageknight can use discern lies as a spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to 3 plus their Intelligence modifier. Their caster level is equal to their class level. This ability replaces the magus arcana gained at 6th level.

Assiduous Gaze (Su/Sp)

At 9th level and again at 15th level, a signifer mageknight gains an assiduous gaze ability chosen from the list on page 12.

A signifer mageknight can use each assiduous gaze ability they possess for a number of rounds per day equal to 1/2 their class level. These rounds need not be consecutive. A signifer mageknight can activate an assiduous gaze ability as a swift action to examine a single creature, object, or 5-foot square within 30 feet. A signifer mageknight must be wearing their signifer mask to use these abilities, and their caster level while using them is equal to their class level.

This ability replaces the magus arcana gained at 9th level and 15th levels.

Infernal Resilience (Ex)

At 11th level, a signifer mageknight gains DR 5/chaotic and becomes immune to poison. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 11th level.

Diabolic Harbinger (Su)

At 20th level, as long as the signifer mageknight wears their signifer mask, they gain telepathy with a range of 100 feet, and can see perfectly in both magical and mundane darkness. While wearing their signifer mask, they are immune to blindness and dazzling effects and gains a +2 bonus on all Charismabased checks when interacting with lawful creatures.

This bonus increases to +4 if the creature is also an outsider. This ability replaces true magus.
